subject: One-off sandbox extension + credit request — Acme AI
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.lin@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: One-off sandbox extension + credit request — Acme AI

Hi Markus / Jordan,

Quick context: Acme (Sara) has been running an evaluation of our hosted sandbox over the past six weeks. They’ve hit a key integration milestone and asked for a short runway extension while they finalize a production POC (jobs will move to Dedicated if approved). Usage and results are promising — their team ran 12 end-to-end flows and the latency/quality numbers look good for their legality workflow. I attached a short usage export (acme_usage_q2.csv) and a draft of proposed sandbox terms.

Ask: Can we approve a one-off 30-day sandbox extension + $4k of free credits (beyond PLG limits) to cover their final round of evals? Acme says the extension materially increases probability of a paid pilot next quarter.

Why this is reasonable:
- They have been active users: ~1.1M tokens over evaluation (see CSV).
- There’s a clear handoff plan to Dedicated if the POC passes (their SRE has committed to a pilot timeline).
- The credit request is modest vs. projected MRR.

If we need an alternate option: we could grant a 30-day extension with rate-limited tokens (soft cap at 500k tokens) instead of unrestricted credits.

Next step: I’d like internal approval (deal desk / exec signoff) to proceed. If OK, I’ll send Sara the updated terms and a small MOU.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
[Attachment: acme_usage_q2.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: proposed_sandbox_terms.pdf (pdf)]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.lin@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off sandbox extension + credit request — Acme AI

On Tue, Jul 18, 2028 at 08:45 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick context: Acme (Sara) has been running an evaluation...

Mina — thanks for the clear summary. Two quick clarifying Qs before I escalate to Deal Desk:
1) Can you confirm the conversion trigger (what exactly will make this paid)? A short list of acceptance criteria would help.
2) Any procurement constraints (PO required, exact billing entity)?

Markus: if you’re comfortable, please add your recommendation. I’m happy to route to Aditya for formal approval once we’ve nailed acceptance criteria.

Jordan
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.lin@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: One-off sandbox extension + credit request — Acme AI

Thanks for the ping. Quick assessment from Deal Desk: the ask (30 days + $4k credits) is within the delegations for AE + Sales Manager to approve in most cases, but because this exceeds typical PLG self-serve caps we need a written exec signoff or a Manager approval with a documented win probability and acceptance criteria.

Recommendations:
- Preferable: grant 30-day extension with a 500k token hard cap and $2k credit applied to overage if they breach the cap. This protects runway while keeping upside.
- Alternate: approve $4k as requested but attach a 15% commercial uplift in pilot pricing if they move to Dedicated within 90 days.

Please add acceptance criteria such as: successful SSO integration, three sample documents processed end-to-end, and SRE readiness confirmation. Once we have that I’ll prepare a Deal Desk sign-off note (and add HS-99827 to the record).

-Aditya
Deal Desk Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

> [Linked reference: HubSpot HS-99827]

Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: One-off sandbox extension + credit request — Acme AI

Team — I’ve reviewed the usage file and Mina’s notes. Recommended path: approve a 30-day sandbox extension with $4k of credit, conditional on the acceptance criteria Aditya listed. I agree to sign this off from a revenue ops perspective, but given this exceeds our standard PLG cap I’m requesting an Exec sign-off for completeness (Laura).

Mina: please confirm acceptance criteria below in the email thread (SSO done, 3 E2E flows, SRE signoff). Once confirmed I’ll circulate a short approval memo for Laura.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: sara.lin@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: One-off sandbox extension + credit request — Acme AI

Thanks everyone for the context and the recommendations. I’ve reviewed the proposed conditions. Formal executive decision: APPROVED.

Terms of approval (to be captured in the Deal Desk memo):
- Grant a one-time 30-day sandbox extension starting 2028-07-20.
- Issue $4,000 in free credits to Acme AI.
- Acceptance criteria (to be validated by Mina and Jordan prior to funding): SSO integration complete, 3 successful end-to-end flows, SRE signoff documented in HubSpot HS-99827.
- If they move to Dedicated within 90 days, apply the agreed commercial uplift in the pilot SOW.

Mina — you have exec signoff. Please share the MOU and notify Sara so they can confirm dates.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
